time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
coordinates: full-res image px, x right, y DOWN. *_bg columns = image coords minus camera shift (camera.csv) = frame-0 background coordinates; use them for motion because the camera pans.

camera.type: handheld, pans to the right following the ball (scene content moves LEFT in the image); a ROTATION, so the shift is non-uniform: at the end about -200 px at the image centre, about -240 px near x~1000 and x~3050, about -265 px near the left/right edges. Use the homography (h00..h22 in camera.csv, frame i -> frame 0) or scene/scripts/camlib.py to_bg(); all *_bg columns already use it.
camera.pan_phases: f0-26 small hand jitter (|dx| < 20 px); f26-70 pan (centre shift reaches about -200 px; fastest about -5 px/frame at f40-56); f70-96 nearly still
camera.note: ORB+RANSAC homography on background (sky/palms/buildings/pole), direct to frame 0. Validated by template-matching static objects (restroom sign, black trash can, backboard logo, hoop pole, far court line, mural): predicted vs measured shift agree within 1-3 px (one motion-blurred frame 11 px).

ball.desc: basketball (brown/orange), the only ball in play; dribbled and shot by shooter_grey_tank

diameter_px_BEST.how: full outline incl. dark shaded edge, against clear sky: f49 45.7 (bbox 46x44), f51 45.5 (46x45), f52 45.9 (46x45), f75 45.1 (44x45), f76 45.2, f77 45.2 (45x45); Hough circle fits mostly 44.6-47.8; visual zoom f51 ~44-46, f6 (dribble) ~42-46. No measurable change of apparent size along the flight. See tracks/ball_diameter.csv.

colour_core_mask_diameter_px (UNDERESTIM.note: diam_eq = sqrt(4*area/pi) of the orange colour mask = only the lit orange core; the dark shaded rim of the ball is excluded, so it is ~10 px smaller than the real outline. The colour-mask centroid is biased ~3-4 px toward the lit (upper-right) side relative to the outline centre, a near-constant offset.

shooter_grey_tank.desc: man in grey/blue sleeveless tank top, black shorts, face blurred; left-centre of the court; dribbles at f0-14 and takes the jump shot

blacktee_redshorts.desc: tall young man, black T-shirt, dark-red shorts, white socks; leftmost player; walks slowly right, faster after f64

big_guy_dark_tee_cap.desc: large man, dark grey T-shirt, black shorts, black Nike cap, black elbow sleeve, knee brace, white sneakers; nearest to camera; walks away/right across the court the whole clip (apparent height shrinks 657 -> 517 px)

red_tracksuit.desc: man in red hoodie (white NYK letters) and red track pants, curly black hair, checkered slip-on shoes; walks right f0-32, turns back left f40-64, then mostly in place

yellow_shorts.desc: man with white tank top / tattoos and yellow-black basketball shorts, face blurred; right of red_tracksuit; often hidden behind him

white_shirt.desc: young man in white/pink T-shirt with pink-white tie-dye shorts and orange-pink shoes; behind big_guy at the start

red_shirt.desc: young man in red T-shirt, black shorts, white leggings, yellow shoes; far side, mostly behind big_guy

bald_black_shirt.desc: bald man in black T-shirt and black shorts, far background near the bleachers, walks slowly left

seated_man_left.desc: man in dark clothes and cap sitting/leaning against the restroom building wall, far left

background_pedestrians.desc: woman in maroon top standing by the HEIDI stand, people on bleachers and boardwalk, person in blue shirt walking far right (f56-96), people in orange near the hoop pole; not tracked

backboard.desc: glass backboard of the court hoop, seen obliquely from the left-front
backboard.note: right (white) edge includes the board thickness/frame seen from the side; board strongly foreshortened, its pixel width is NOT its true width

rim.desc: orange hoop rim with white net
rim.note: rim seen nearly edge-on; right side merges with the orange bracket, horizontal extent uncertain +-8 px

hoop_pole.desc: grey steel pole holding the backboard (two upper braces + lower horizontal arm)
hoop_pole.note: pole stands behind the backboard; its base is the nearest ground reference to the hoop. Rim y (1136) is about 609 px above the pole base y (1745) at f80, but the rim is closer to the camera than the pole so this is only approximate as a rim height.

trash_can_black.desc: black metal trash can on the court edge left of the hoop pole

trash_can_green.desc: green trash can in front of the white bleachers, left-centre

bleachers.desc: white metal bleachers behind the court centre

restroom_building.desc: grey Venice Beach public restroom building with blue sign, left background

court_markings.desc: blue-grey court; white key / free-throw circle and three-point arc lines in the foreground and around red_tracksuit; dark blue arc (old marking) lower left

palm_trees.desc: many palm trees in the background; one tall palm enters at the right edge from ~f48 due to the pan

events.event: clip start: shooter holding ball at right hand, starting a dribble (ball moving down)
ball bounces on the ground (dribble), lowest centre y=1737
ball back in shooter hands (gather), starts upward shooting motion
ball raised to set point above head (centre y ~1406-1418, nearly still f33-41)
shooter feet leave ground (small hop, lowest shoe point rises ~20-25 px)
release: last fingertip contact f46, first free-flight frame f47
ball reaches the rim (front of rim)
ball inside net; horizontal direction reverses (x max at f83 then decreasing)
ball exits bottom of net (made basket)
ball falls toward ground, passes behind red_tracksuit; hidden from f95
